The '''Mylok system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the planet [[Mylok IV]].

It was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Mylok IV|campaign]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] to obtain experimental [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology from [[Habeen]] and [[Nharwaak]] researchers.
